title: Sage-Evolve-Preview:Adaptive Observation for Post-Training Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.26132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training recursive self-improvement (RSI) iteratively improves a target capability, operationalized by a fixed anchor benchmark, through repeated intervention, training, and evaluation. Yet most loops use the anchor's aggregate score as their sole observation, so early gains give way to stalled progress and repetitive exploration. When this anchor-only feedback ceases to reveal actionable gaps, a plateau may reflect an exhausted observation rather than an exhausted capability. We introduce adaptive observation (AdaObs), an observation-side mechanism of harness evolution that keeps the anchor objective fixed while adapting the active observation. At a plateau, a controller refines diagnostic granularity, escalates difficulty, and adds related tasks; validated increments are fused back into training, while every checkpoint remains evaluated against the anchor. translated_title: Sage-Evolve-Preview：面向后训练自我改进的自适应观察
translated_abstract: 后训练递归自我改进（RSI）通过反复的干预、训练和评估，迭代地提升某一目标能力，该能力由一个固定的锚点基准来衡量。然而，大多数循环仅将锚点的聚合分数作为唯一观察，导致早期收益让位于停滞的进展和重复的探索。当这种仅依赖锚点的反馈不再揭示可操作的差距时，平台期可能反映的是观察的枯竭，而非能力的枯竭。我们提出了自适应观察，这是一种工具演化的观察侧机制，它在保持锚点目标不变的同时调整活跃观察。在遇到平台期时，控制器会细化诊断粒度、提升任务难度并添加相关任务；经过验证的增量会被融合回训练中，而每个检查点仍然对照锚点进行评估。在八个独立优化的锚点上（涉及长文本阅读理解等任务）……
tldr: 针对递归自我改进循环中仅依赖锚点基准聚合分数导致进展停滞的问题，本文提出自适应观察（AdaObs）机制，在保持锚点目标不变的前提下，于平台期动态细化诊断粒度、提升难度并扩展相关任务，从而突破由“观察枯竭”造成的改进瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Adaptive Observation (AdaObs), an observation-side mechanism that keeps the anchor benchmark fixed while dynamically refining diagnostic granularity, escalating difficulty, and adding related tasks at plateaus, thereby overcoming stalled progress in post-training recursive self-improvement caused by exhausted observations.
